name: vesicle_grow_divide_220f
error: ValueError("D1: operator-side `every=2` is no longer supported -- the engine owns the clock. (A private period multiplied the engine's, so `every: 2` meant once every 4 frames and every per-call quantity meant 4x what it said.) If this spec was written for the OLD semantics, its true period was 2x the engine's -- convert it and set `every: 4`. Then declare `engine_clock: true` beside it to confirm the period is now engine-owned.")
